title: Jetstar/Batik Business Non-Stop Rtn: BNE-Osaka $1508, PER-KL $1560, BNE-Tokyo $1583, MEL-Sing $1743, SYD-Seoul $1822 @ Skyspy
body:
Deal: Jetstar/Batik Business Non-Stop Rtn: BNE-Osaka $1508, PER-KL $1560, BNE-Tokyo $1583, MEL-Sing $1743, SYD-Seoul $1822 @ Skyspy

[Craki1] Jetstar? Business? I can't connect the two
[martyn] Imagine most other airlines premium economy but slightly worse
[Doyen] Vegan leather, Almond milk, now Jetstar business.
[Lizard Spock] I love traveling on Batik Business with my friend. We go so often the English flight attendants started calling us Batik Boys.
[Almost Banned] The flight I booked on Batik PER to KUL was cancelled (prob never existed).
They wanted to bump me to the next day - costing me an entire day of holiday - but I pushed them to get me on the same day.
Then they made me fly via DPS to KUL - a much longer trip but at least it was the same day.
They landed so hard at DPS they wouldn't let them take off again without engineering checking the plane. By the time they did that, they needed a new crew. By the time they sorted that, we had been waiting at DPS for half a day.
Our quick trip to KL had turned into a full day nightmare. Got into KUL after midnight, and into KL around 2am.
No apologies. No compensation. No nothing from Batik.
Be warned.
[Skyspy] Jeez ok i was not aware of this reputation, noted thanks
[MaxHashrate] No point to pay for batik business. It is often not full. Just offer to pay more on check in and U will probably get it cheaper
[evgpek] After Jetstar cancelled my NZ flight and rebooked me for another one day earlier they reimbursed me for additional hotel night via chat almost instantly. 👍
Virgin on the other hand cancelled flights to Samoa and refused to rebook or compensate for non-refundable accommodation. 💩
(Both were due to schedule change, not weather)
YMMV
[Stewardo] You’d be better off booking premium economy on a good airline than these deals.
[bunnybash] Not gonna lie. Air Asia and Batik air are always a risk. I’ve owned a travel agency for just under a year now and there’s some airlines we refuse to book people on. Air Asia is one of them. We reluctantly book Batik.
